tabs.content:
.create table eco2mix_tr (
    code_region: string, 
    libelle_region: string, 
    ts_utc: datetime,
    consommation: real, 
    thermique: real, 
    nucleaire: real, 
    eolien: real,
    solaire: real, 
    hydraulique: real, 
    bioenergies: real,
    pompage: real, 
    ech_physiques: real,
    fetched_at_utc: datetime
)

.show ingestion failures
| where Table == "eco2mix_tr"
tabs.title: table eco2mix_tr

tabs.content:
.create-or-alter function with (folder = "transform") f_eco2mix_tr_typage() {
    eco2mix_tr_raw
    | project
        code_region    = tostring(code_insee_region),
        libelle_region = tostring(libelle_region),
        ts_utc         = todatetime(date_heure),
        consommation   = toreal(consommation),
        thermique      = toreal(thermique),
        nucleaire      = toreal(nucleaire),
        eolien         = toreal(eolien),
        solaire        = toreal(solaire),
        hydraulique    = toreal(hydraulique),
        bioenergies    = toreal(bioenergies),
        pompage        = toreal(pompage),
        ech_physiques  = toreal(ech_physiques),
        fetched_at_utc = todatetime(fetched_at_utc)
}

f_eco2mix_tr_typage() | take 10

.create-or-alter function with (folder = "serve") f_dernier_etat() {
    mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup
    | where isnotnull(consommation)
    | summarize arg_max(ts_utc, *) by code_region
}

f_dernier_etat() | take 10
tabs.title: f_eco2mix_tr_typage

tabs.content:
.alter table eco2mix_tr policy update
@'[{"IsEnabled": true, "Source": "eco2mix_tr_raw", "Query": "f_eco2mix_tr_typage()", "IsTransactional": false}]'
tabs.title: policy

tabs.content:
.create materialized-view with (backfill = true) mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup on table eco2mix_tr {
    eco2mix_tr
    | summarize arg_max(fetched_at_utc, *) by code_region, ts_utc
}

mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup | count
materialized_view("mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup")

.show materialized-view mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup
tabs.title: Materialized View

tabs.content:
//Délai de publication
let debut_producteur = toscalar(eco2mix_tr | summarize min(fetched_at_utc));
eco2mix_tr
| where isnotnull(consommation) and ts_utc > debut_producteur
| summarize premiere_valeur =  min(fetched_at_utc) by code_region, ts_utc
| extend delai_win = (premiere_valeur - ts_utc) / 1m
| summarize p50 = percentile(delai_win, 50), p95 = percentile(delai_win, 95)

//Nombre de versions différentes
eco2mix_tr
| summarize versions = dcount(tostring(consommation)) by code_region, ts_utc
| summarize nb_quarts = count() by versions
| order by versions asc

//Anomalie de consommation
mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup
| where ts_utc > ago(8d) and isnotnull(consommation)
| make-series conso = avg(consommation) default = real(null) on ts_utc step 15min by libelle_region
| extend conso = series_fill_linear(conso)
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(conso, 2.5)
| render anomalychart with (anomalycolumns=anomalies)
tabs.title: Analyse

tabs.content:
.create-or-alter function with (folder = "serve") f_mix_national(debut: datetime, fin: datetime){
    let nb_regions = toscalar(mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup | summarize dcount(code_region));
    mv_eco2mix_tr_dedup
    | where ts_utc  between (debut .. fin)
    | summarize regions_ok = countif(isnotnull(consommation)),
                thermique = sum(thermique), nucleaire = sum(nucleaire), eolien = sum(eolien),
                solaire = sum(solaire), hydraulique = sum(hydraulique), bioenergies = sum(bioenergies),
                consommation = sum(consommation)
        by ts_utc
    | where regions_ok == nb_regions
    | extend production = thermique + nucleaire + eolien + solaire + hydraulique + bioenergies
    | extend part_thermique = thermique / production
}
tabs.title: f_mix_national
